title: Interruptions; the show's New York chorus line
summary: The interviewer complains about noise in the next room, then asks about the show's chorus girls and how the company came together in Chicago.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: I want to say this, George Ween is a pest. I'm going to send him a bill for wasted tape.
Yeah, man. All the time. I should never give him-
He goes in the other room and starts yelling his head off while I'm talking to Pop Foster here. I'm getting some vital information. Did you break the show in Chicago, you mean?
James P. came to Chicago, everybody came there and decided-
Well, we had a couple girls from Chicago, but the Red Bumet, there was about ten girls all together.
They're all New York girls. When you say that that was a line?
Yes. And I'm walking good line too. Yeah. Did you make it with any other? Uh-huh. Did you make it with any other girls?
Did you make it with any of those girls, I said?
Oh, you didn't have your eyes on those girls? No.
Yeah, I had them on them, but-
